description: The bar chart titled “Factual Errors” illustrates the number of factual errors across three datasets for three QA methods. The horizontal axis contains the category labels HotpotQA, MuSiQue, and IIRC (left to right), and the vertical axis is a numeric count scale running from 0 to 40 on a linear scale with tick marks at regular 5-unit intervals. For each dataset, three adjacent bars are shown as a grouped arrangement corresponding to the legend: “NoR QA” (orange with a crosshatch pattern), “OneR QA” (red with a dotted pattern), and “IRCoT QA” (dark blue with diagonal hatch). In HotpotQA, the bars are labeled 15 (NoR QA), 10 (OneR QA), and 5 (IRCoT QA). In MuSiQue, the bars are labeled 28 (NoR QA), 27 (OneR QA), and 23 (IRCoT QA). In IIRC, the bars are labeled 15 (NoR QA), 14 (OneR QA), and 11 (IRCoT QA). Values are printed above each bar, there is no visible sorting beyond the fixed dataset order on the x-axis, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond their distinct colors and hatch patterns.
